fact.en:
What is an electric circuit?

It is a closed loop through which current can flow, like a complete circle of wires that lets electrons travel from the source, through the loads, and back again.
fact.tl:
Ano ang electric circuit?

Ito ay isang closed loop kung saan dumadaloy ang current, parang kumpletong bilog ng wires na nagpapadaan sa mga electron mula sa source, papunta sa mga load, at pabalik muli.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang electric circuit?

Kini usa ka closed loop diin moagi ang current, sama sa kompleto nga lingin sa wires nga magpaagi sa mga electron gikan sa source, ngadto sa mga load, ug balik pag-usab.

cards.illustration: A simple circle of wire connecting a battery to a small light bulb, with arrows showing electrons moving around the loop.

fact.en: For electrons to flow continuously, there must be a complete circuit with no gaps, so a break anywhere stops the current everywhere.
fact.tl: Para tuloy-tuloy ang daloy ng mga electron, kailangan kumpleto ang circuit na walang puwang, kaya kapag may naputol kahit saan, hihinto ang current sa lahat ng bahagi.
fact.bis: Aron padayon ang pag-agos sa mga electron, kinahanglan kompleto ang circuit nga walay puwang, busa kung adunay maputol bisan asa, mohunong ang current sa tanang parte.

cards.illustration: A battery connected to a light bulb by wires, with a small gap in one wire and the bulb unlit.

fact.en: An electric circuit has at least three parts: a voltage source like a battery, conducting wires for the current to pass through, and loads like light bulbs that use the energy.
fact.tl: Ang electric circuit ay may hindi bababa sa tatlong bahagi: voltage source tulad ng battery, conducting wires na dinadaanan ng current, at mga load tulad ng light bulbs na gumagamit ng enerhiya.
fact.bis: Ang electric circuit adunay labing menos tulo ka parte: voltage source sama sa battery, conducting wires nga agianan sa current, ug mga load sama sa light bulbs nga mogamit sa enerhiya.

cards.illustration: A labeled diagram showing a battery, two wires, and a light bulb connected in a simple loop.

fact.en:
How does a switch turn a light on and off?

A switch opens or closes a gap in the circuit; when it is on, the circuit is closed and current flows, and when it is off, the circuit is open and current stops.
fact.tl:
Paano binubuksan at pinapatay ng switch ang ilaw?

Binubuksan o isinasara ng switch ang puwang sa circuit; kapag naka-on, closed ang circuit at dumadaloy ang current, at kapag naka-off, open ang circuit at humihinto ang current.
fact.bis:
Giunsa pagpasiga ug pagpalong sa switch ang suga?

Giablihan o gisirhan sa switch ang puwang sa circuit; kung naka-on, closed ang circuit ug moagos ang current, ug kung naka-off, open ang circuit ug mohunong ang current.

cards.illustration: A hand flipping a wall switch, with a light bulb turning on as the circuit closes.

fact.en: In a series circuit, current flows along only one pathway, so all the loads share the same single loop of wire.
fact.tl: Sa series circuit, iisa lang ang dinadaanan ng current, kaya lahat ng load ay nakikibahagi sa iisang loop ng wire.
fact.bis: Sa series circuit, usa ra ka agianan ang current, busa ang tanang load mag-ambit sa usa ra ka loop sa wire.

cards.illustration: A single loop of wire connecting a battery to two light bulbs one after another, with arrows showing one path for current.

fact.en: In a series circuit, the total resistance is the sum of all individual resistances, so adding more loads makes the total resistance larger.
fact.tl: Sa series circuit, ang total resistance ay ang kabuuan ng lahat ng individual resistances, kaya kapag nagdagdag ng load, lumalaki ang total resistance.
fact.bis: Sa series circuit, ang total resistance mao ang sum sa tanang individual resistances, busa kung magdugang og load, modako ang total resistance.

cards.illustration: Three light bulbs in a row with small resistance numbers beside each, and a larger total resistance number beside the whole row.

fact.en: In a series circuit, the voltage source equals the sum of the voltages across each load, so the loads share the total voltage.
fact.tl: Sa series circuit, ang voltage source ay katumbas ng kabuuan ng voltages sa bawat load, kaya pinaghahatian ng mga load ang total voltage.
fact.bis: Sa series circuit, ang voltage source katumbas sa sum sa mga voltage sa matag load, busa ang mga load mag-ambit sa total voltage.

cards.illustration: A battery connected to three light bulbs in a row, with voltage labels showing how the battery voltage splits among the bulbs.

fact.en: In a series circuit, the current is constant across each load, so every load receives the same amount of current.
fact.tl: Sa series circuit, pare-pareho ang current sa bawat load, kaya lahat ng load ay tumatanggap ng magkaparehong dami ng current.
fact.bis: Sa series circuit, parehas ang current sa matag load, busa ang tanang load makadawat og parehas nga gidaghanon sa current.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with three light bulbs, each showing the same current value flowing through them.

fact.en:
What happens if one bulb burns out in a series circuit?

The other bulbs will not work because the burned-out bulb breaks the single pathway, opening the circuit and stopping all current.
fact.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kung mapundi ang isang bulb sa series circuit?

Hindi na gagana ang ibang bulbs dahil naputol ng pundidong bulb ang nag-iisang daanan, kaya nabuksan ang circuit at huminto ang lahat ng current.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo kung mapundi ang usa ka bulb sa series circuit?

Dili na mogana ang uban nga bulbs tungod kay naputol sa pundido nga bulb ang usa ra ka agianan, busa naablihan ang circuit ug mihunong ang tanang current.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with three bulbs, one bulb dark and broken, and the other two bulbs also dark.

fact.en: Series circuits are commonly used in Christmas lights, where many small bulbs are connected one after another in a single loop.
fact.tl: Ang series circuits ay karaniwang ginagamit sa Christmas lights, kung saan maraming maliliit na bulbs ang magkakasunod na nakakabit sa iisang loop.
fact.bis: Ang series circuits kasagarang gigamit sa Christmas lights, diin daghang gagmay nga bulbs ang sunod-sunod nga nakakabit sa usa ra ka loop.

cards.illustration: A string of small Christmas lights connected in a single line, with one bulb glowing and the rest following the same wire.

fact.en: In a parallel circuit, current flows along more than one pathway, so each load has its own separate branch from the voltage source.
fact.tl: Sa parallel circuit, dumadaloy ang current sa higit sa isang daanan, kaya bawat load ay may sariling branch mula sa voltage source.
fact.bis: Sa parallel circuit, moagos ang current sa labaw sa usa ka agianan, busa ang matag load adunay kaugalingong branch gikan sa voltage source.

cards.illustration: A battery connected to three light bulbs, each bulb on its own separate wire branch from the battery.

fact.en: Home appliances and light bulbs are usually connected in parallel, so each one can be switched off without affecting the others.
fact.tl: Ang mga appliances at light bulbs sa bahay ay karaniwang nakakabit nang parallel, kaya bawat isa ay maaaring patayin nang hindi naaapektuhan ang iba.
fact.bis: Ang mga appliances ug light bulbs sa balay kasagarang nakakabit nga parallel, busa ang matag usa mahimong palungon nga dili maapektuhan ang uban.

cards.illustration: A house with several rooms, each showing a light bulb and appliance connected to separate wires from the main power line.

fact.en: In a parallel circuit, every load receives the same voltage as the source, so all bulbs can shine at their maximum brightness.
fact.tl: Sa parallel circuit, bawat load ay tumatanggap ng parehong voltage mula sa source, kaya lahat ng bulbs ay maaaring sumindi sa pinakamaliwanag nila.
fact.bis: Sa parallel circuit, ang matag load makadawat og parehas nga voltage sama sa source, busa ang tanang bulbs makasiga sa ilang kinadak-ang kahayag.

cards.illustration: A battery connected to three bulbs on separate branches, each bulb glowing with equal brightness.

fact.en: In a parallel circuit, the total current is the sum of the currents in each branch, so adding more loads increases the total current.
fact.tl: Sa parallel circuit, ang total current ay ang kabuuan ng mga current sa bawat branch, kaya kapag nagdagdag ng load, tumataas ang total current.
fact.bis: Sa parallel circuit, ang total current mao ang sum sa mga current sa matag branch, busa kung magdugang og load, motaas ang total current.

cards.illustration: A parallel circuit with three branches, each showing a current value, and a larger total current value near the battery.

fact.en: In a parallel circuit, the total resistance is always less than the smallest individual resistance, because the current has more pathways to flow through.
fact.tl: Sa parallel circuit, ang total resistance ay palaging mas mababa kaysa pinakamaliit na individual resistance, dahil mas maraming daanan ang current.
fact.bis: Sa parallel circuit, ang total resistance kanunay nga mas ubos kaysa kinagamyan nga individual resistance, tungod kay mas daghan og agianan ang current.

cards.illustration: A parallel circuit with three resistors, showing the total resistance value smaller than each individual resistor value.

fact.en:
What happens if you remove one light bulb from a series circuit?

The other bulbs will not work because removing the bulb creates a gap, and the single pathway is broken.
fact.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kung tatanggalin mo ang isang light bulb sa series circuit?

Hindi na gagana ang ibang bulbs dahil nagkaroon ng puwang nang tanggalin ang bulb, at naputol ang nag-iisang daanan.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo kung tangtangon nimo ang usa ka light bulb sa series circuit?

Dili na mogana ang uban nga bulbs tungod kay adunay puwang sa pagtangtang sa bulb, ug naputol ang usa ra ka agianan.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with one bulb removed from its socket, leaving a gap, and the remaining bulbs unlit.

fact.en:
What happens if you remove one light bulb from a parallel circuit?

The other bulbs will continue to light because each bulb has its own separate pathway, so the current still flows through the other branches.
fact.tl:
Ano ang mangyayari kung tatanggalin mo ang isang light bulb sa parallel circuit?

Patuloy pa ring sisindi ang ibang bulbs dahil bawat bulb ay may sariling daanan, kaya dumadaloy pa rin ang current sa ibang branches.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang mahitabo kung tangtangon nimo ang usa ka light bulb sa parallel circuit?

Padayon nga mosiga ang uban nga bulbs tungod kay ang matag bulb adunay kaugalingong agianan, busa moagos pa ang current sa uban nga branches.

cards.illustration: A parallel circuit with three bulbs, one bulb removed from its socket, and the other two bulbs still glowing.

fact.en: Adding more light bulbs in a series circuit causes the brightness of the bulbs to decrease, because the bulbs share the fixed voltage from the source.
fact.tl: Kapag nagdagdag ng maraming light bulbs sa series circuit, humihina ang liwanag ng mga bulbs, dahil pinaghahatian ng mga bulbs ang fixed voltage mula sa source.
fact.bis: Kung magdugang og daghang light bulbs sa series circuit, mokunhod ang kahayag sa mga bulbs, tungod kay ang mga bulbs mag-ambit sa fixed voltage gikan sa source.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with many bulbs, each bulb glowing dimly compared to a single bright bulb beside it.

fact.en: A series circuit does not overheat easily, because adding more loads increases the total resistance and reduces the amount of current flowing.
fact.tl: Ang series circuit ay hindi madaling mag-overheat, dahil kapag nagdagdag ng load, tumataas ang total resistance at bumababa ang dami ng current na dumadaloy.
fact.bis: Ang series circuit dili dali nga mag-overheat, tungod kay kung magdugang og load, motaas ang total resistance ug mokunhod ang gidaghanon sa current nga moagos.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with several bulbs, all glowing coolly, with a thermometer showing a low temperature.

fact.en:
Why can too many appliances in parallel cause a fire?

Adding more loads in parallel decreases the total resistance, so a very large current flows through the wires, which can overheat them and start a fire.
fact.tl:
Bakit maaaring magdulot ng sunog ang napakaraming appliances na naka-parallel?

Kapag nagdagdag ng load sa parallel, bumababa ang total resistance, kaya napakalaking current ang dumadaloy sa wires, na maaaring mag-overheat at magsimula ng sunog.
fact.bis:
Ngano makapahinabog sunog ang daghan kaayong appliances nga naka-parallel?

Kung magdugang og load sa parallel, mokunhod ang total resistance, busa hilabihan ka dako nga current ang moagos sa wires, nga mahimong mag-overheat ug makasugod og sunog.

cards.illustration: Many appliances plugged into one outlet, with wires glowing hot and a warning symbol nearby.

fact.en: In a series circuit, all loads are difficult to control individually, because one switch controls the entire single pathway.
fact.tl: Sa series circuit, mahirap kontrolin nang isa-isa ang mga load, dahil isang switch lang ang kumokontrol sa buong nag-iisang daanan.
fact.bis: Sa series circuit, lisod kontrolon nga tagsa-tagsa ang mga load, tungod kay usa ra ka switch ang nagkontrol sa tibuok usa ka agianan.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with one switch controlling three bulbs, all bulbs turning off together when the switch is opened.

fact.en: In a parallel circuit, each load is easy to control individually, because each branch can have its own switch without affecting the other branches.
fact.tl: Sa parallel circuit, madaling kontrolin nang isa-isa ang bawat load, dahil bawat branch ay maaaring magkaroon ng sariling switch nang hindi naaapektuhan ang ibang branches.
fact.bis: Sa parallel circuit, sayon kontrolon nga tagsa-tagsa ang matag load, tungod kay ang matag branch mahimong adunay kaugalingong switch nga dili maapektuhan ang uban nga branches.

cards.illustration: A parallel circuit with three bulbs, each with its own switch, one switch off and the other two bulbs still glowing.

fact.en: A series circuit is easy to install and maintain, because it uses only one simple loop of wire with no branches.
fact.tl: Ang series circuit ay madaling i-install at panatilihin, dahil gumagamit lamang ito ng isang simpleng loop ng wire na walang branches.
fact.bis: Ang series circuit sayon nga i-install ug atimanon, tungod kay mogamit lamang kini og usa ka simple nga loop sa wire nga walay branches.

cards.illustration: A simple single loop of wire connecting a battery to two bulbs, with no extra branches.

fact.en: A parallel circuit is difficult to install and repair, because it requires a large volume of conducting wires with many separate branches.
fact.tl: Ang parallel circuit ay mahirap i-install at kumpunihin, dahil nangangailangan ito ng maraming conducting wires na may maraming hiwalay na branches.
fact.bis: Ang parallel circuit lisod nga i-install ug ayohon, tungod kay nagkinahanglan kini og daghang conducting wires nga adunay daghang bulag nga branches.

cards.illustration: A complex parallel circuit with many wires and branches, showing the difficulty of tracing each pathway.

fact.en: It is difficult to identify the damaged bulb in a series circuit, because when one bulb fails, all the bulbs go dark together.
fact.tl: Mahirap matukoy ang sirang bulb sa series circuit, dahil kapag napundi ang isang bulb, lahat ng bulbs ay sabay-sabay na mamamatay.
fact.bis: Lisod mailhan ang nadaot nga bulb sa series circuit, tungod kay kung mapundi ang usa ka bulb, ang tanang bulbs magdungan og kapatay.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with several dark bulbs, a person looking confused about which bulb is broken.

fact.en: In a parallel circuit, if one light bulb is damaged, the other bulbs will still function, because the current is not entirely interrupted.
fact.tl: Sa parallel circuit, kung masira ang isang light bulb, gagana pa rin ang ibang bulbs, dahil hindi tuluyang napuputol ang daloy ng current.
fact.bis: Sa parallel circuit, kung madaot ang usa ka light bulb, mogana pa ang uban nga bulbs, tungod kay dili hingpit nga maputol ang pag-agos sa current.

cards.illustration: A parallel circuit with one broken bulb and the other bulbs still glowing brightly.

fact.en: In a series circuit, the load with higher resistance has a greater amount of voltage across it, causing it to convert more electrical energy to light and heat.
fact.tl: Sa series circuit, ang load na may mas mataas na resistance ay may mas malaking voltage sa kabila nito, kaya mas maraming electrical energy ang nagiging liwanag at init.
fact.bis: Sa series circuit, ang load nga adunay mas taas nga resistance adunay mas dako nga voltage sa atbang niini, busa mas daghang electrical energy ang mahimong kahayag ug init.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with two bulbs, one with higher resistance glowing brighter and hotter than the other.

fact.en: All loads in a parallel connection are directly connected to the voltage source, so even if resistances vary, all light bulbs can still have their maximum brightness.
fact.tl: Ang lahat ng load sa parallel connection ay direktang nakakabit sa voltage source, kaya kahit magkakaiba ang resistances, lahat ng light bulbs ay maaari pa ring magkaroon ng pinakamataas na liwanag.
fact.bis: Ang tanang load sa parallel connection direktang nakakabit sa voltage source, busa bisan magkalahi ang resistances, ang tanang light bulbs makabaton gihapon sa ilang kinadak-ang kahayag.

cards.illustration: A parallel circuit with bulbs of different sizes, all glowing at full brightness.

fact.en: The more loads connected in a series circuit, the lower the amount of current, because the total resistance increases.
fact.tl: Kapag mas maraming load ang nakakabit sa series circuit, mas bumababa ang dami ng current, dahil tumataas ang total resistance.
fact.bis: Kung mas daghan ang load nga nakakabit sa series circuit, mas mokunhod ang gidaghanon sa current, tungod kay motaas ang total resistance.

cards.illustration: A series circuit with many bulbs, showing a small current value compared to a circuit with fewer bulbs.

fact.en: The more loads added in a parallel connection, the lower the total resistance and the higher the total current, which can lead to overloading.
fact.tl: Kapag mas maraming load ang idinagdag sa parallel connection, mas bumababa ang total resistance at mas tumataas ang total current, na maaaring magdulot ng overloading.
fact.bis: Kung mas daghan ang load nga idugang sa parallel connection, mas mokunhod ang total resistance ug mas motaas ang total current, nga mahimong hinungdan sa overloading.

cards.illustration: A parallel circuit with many branches, showing a large current value near the battery and warning signs.

fact.en: Electrons flow from the negative terminal of a battery, where there are abundant negative charges, through the load and switch, and back to the positive terminal.
fact.tl: Ang mga electron ay dumadaloy mula sa negative terminal ng battery, kung saan maraming negative charges, papunta sa load at switch, at pabalik sa positive terminal.
fact.bis: Ang mga electron moagos gikan sa negative terminal sa battery, diin daghan ang negative charges, ngadto sa load ug switch, ug balik sa positive terminal.

cards.illustration: A battery with arrows showing electrons moving from the negative terminal through a bulb and back to the positive terminal.
